authority: Only authoritative Engine decode/capture and a trusted registered versioned format rule can classify footprint and external-reference closure. A client/codec-supplied accepted flag or rule digest is not trust.
default: Every unsupported block defaults to unknown-whole-persistent-source and referenceClosure=unknown. Before edited/native whole-save, compare the authoritative persistent source projection and all baseline contexts. Any changed persistent field, schema/policy, resource graph or reference namespace refuses E_UNSAFE_SOURCE_REWRITE. A document revision alone is not a persistent-content test.
persistentProjection: Hash the complete authoritative persistent source tree using frozen roles. Exclude only specifically frozen derived dependency-baseline bookkeeping fields from this projection to avoid self-referential digests; those fields remain identity-only units in CompleteSourceAudit and are included in plan/source/report digests. Never exclude arbitrary metadata/new fields. Unchanged transient selection need not change the persistent projection.
baseline: sourceTypeDigest/policyDigest/resourceGraphDigest/referenceNamespaceDigest plus persistentSourceDigest from original decode/capture. Reference namespace binds captured primary location/base and reference resolution rules, so SaveAs/relocation cannot pass solely because primary raw bytes are unchanged.
qualified: A trusted rule generates all exact owner/RFC6901/unit-digest footprint identities from the authoritative source, and declares reference closure. Engine independently recomputes them; duplicates, unresolved owners/pointers, changed dependencies, unknown/new type or missing units refuse. Whole-source changes outside a proven complete footprint can proceed only when all fixed contexts match.
references: Unknown external-reference closure never confirms a whole project/package Saved, even if a block is copied exactly. Complete-no-external-references or complete-verified-resource-graph must derive from the trusted format rule and independent reference/byte verification. Copying original source for diagnostic inspection is distinct from edited/preserving project Save.
candidate: Every opaque-preserved disposition requires exact source extent and actual candidate byte witness. The existing editDependencyDigest is SHA256 of a canonical closed envelope containing proposal version, owner/id, format/dialect, source extent/raw SHA, dependency record and trusted rule identity. No unbound digest or codec-only unchanged flag.
framing: If block byte extent or nesting/termination is ambiguous, retain the entire original file as source-only; do not guess a block boundary or patch a token that could belong to unknown content.
unsupportedChanges: Do not silently drop/reindex/retarget an unsupported block after sites/labels/basis/frame/field/resources/scene change. Loss consent cannot qualify a falsely described whole-preserving Save; an existing separate export must follow its own admitted purpose and explicit loss policy.
futureEvidence: actual derived Engine persistent projection/role conformance
trusted rule dependency-completeness validation against authoritative types
actual candidate bytes and independent full resource-reference closure
native/product fresh reopen under authorized implementation
